summary: Data migration planned for populating normalized target tables.
reasoning: Identified source columns from multiple source tables to populate each target table.
Ensured no redundancy by selecting distinct entries where applicable, particularly for lookup tables.
Constructed SQL statements as INSERT INTO ... SELECT for each target table based on identified sources and requirements.

statements.sql:
INSERT INTO course (course_id, course_name, department_name) 
SELECT DISTINCT __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_name, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.department_name FROM __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course;
statements.purpose: Populate course information from source courses to eliminate redundancy.

statements.sql:
INSERT INTO instructor (instructor_id, instructor_name) 
SELECT DISTINCT __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor_name FROM __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor_name FROM __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course JOIN __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.enrollment_flat ON __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor_id = __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor_id;
statements.purpose: Populate instructor details from source instructors and courses to eliminate redundancy.

statements.sql:
INSERT INTO student (student_id, student_name, student_email) 
SELECT DISTINCT __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student_name, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student_email FROM __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student_name, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student_email FROM __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.enrollment_flat;
statements.purpose: Populate student details from source students and enrollment to eliminate redundancy.

statements.sql:
INSERT INTO enrollment (enrollment_id, student_id, course_id, semester, grade) 
SELECT __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.enrollment_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.student_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.semester, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.grade FROM __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.enrollment JOIN __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.enrollment_flat ON __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_id = __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_id;
statements.purpose: Populate enrollment records by linking students and courses.

statements.sql:
INSERT INTO course_instructor (course_id, instructor_id) 
SELECT DISTINCT __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_id, __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.instructor_id FROM __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course JOIN __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.enrollment_flat ON __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_id = __SOURCE_SCHEMA__.course_id;
statements.purpose: Link courses with their respective instructors to reduce redundancy.
